section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the design and procedure of a single longitudinal, double-blind, randomly assigned group study. Participants were recruited from facilities and assigned to either a treatment group (daily gratitude exercise) or a control group, completing a 21-day survey. An initial sample of 42 participants (23 treatment, 19 control) was reduced to a final analytical sample of N=36 based on survey compliance.
